# Tiny Tasks
A small task tracker for registered users.

## Authentication
Users must be able to create an account and sign in.

## Tasks
Users must be able to create tasks with a title.

## Security
Passwords must be stored as salted hashes.

## Performance
Task lists should load within 500 ms for 100 tasks.

## Technical constraints
The backend must use Node.js.

## Out of scope
Mobile applications are out of scope for V1.

## Open questions
Should task titles have a maximum length?
